answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 22051 Country: AU Title: I saw a dream that i have gone blind in one eye / or it was a feeling that i cannot see from one eye . what does this mean? Question: I saw a dream that i have gone blind in one eye / or it was a feeling that i cannot see from one eye . what does this mean? Answer ID: 22051 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 696/527/D=1431) There is stern warning in the dream that you are extremely lagging behind in practicing religious duties and Islamic rulings. Assess your deeds and by keeping the company of good and pious people bring firmness in your iman and good deeds. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
